prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, a secret 1930s basement speakeasy seen side-on and wide like a lit stage: rows of black iron printing presses with simple faces painted on their sides throw blank green paper money with no printing into the air under emerald lamps; a band of gangsters in pinstripe suits plays trumpet, double bass and drums on a little stage with scarlet curtains; a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache dances on a table. On the right wall, a huge iron lever with a red bulb flashing above it, and a young gangster with slicked red hair and freckles lunging at it in panic, both hands out. Most of the frame warm shadow; the brightest values are the emerald lamps, the flying notes and the red bulb. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
